name: Journey to Kaizo
summary: A collaborative Super Mario World Kaizo ROM hack created by Team J2K, an international group of over 30 designers. Playing as Reimu, you explore a Super Mario Land 2-inspired semi-open overworld across six regions to collect six Golden Coins and find your missing father. Built for intermediate players, the 38-exit hack blends vanilla and custom platforming mechanics alongside custom cutscenes, original music ports, optional Moon Challenges, and a dedicated Practice Playground.
